transcript:
MARTIN: Smoke? Isn't it soaking wet in there?

DAVID: Yeah, but I swear I smell smoke. Strong too, man. Like I'm standing next to a campfire.

[SFX: He steps on some burned wood, it cracks beneath each step - he treads carefully. The rain beats down around him.]

DAVID (presenter voice): There are burnt wood beams lining the whole area. I think they are from when the roof collapsed... You can see where the beams were moved to get the bodies out... There’s a large clearing in the middle of the room. It looks like the people must have been in one place...
